rows.coder_note: Cohort name with endpoint counts (8288 cases, 68,969 controls) and the Kurki 2023 citation, which is the source of every FinnGen row; no release number and no attribute that separates the rows (rules E, I1).
Cohort name with case and control counts (1496; 359,698) and a citation to the general UK Biobank resource paper (Bycroft 2018); no GWAS release, accession or provider is named (rules D, I1).

rows.quote: The plasma protein GWAS data adopted in this article were sourced from UKB-PPP (https://www.synapse.org/#!Synapse:syn51364943/files/), which involved plasma proteomic analysis of 54,219 participants, exhibited pQTLs mapping of 2923 proteins, and identified 14,287 dominating genetic associations, of which 81% have not been previously reported.[15]
rows.coder_note: The sentence gives a repository accession (Synapse syn51364943) that no dictionary row lists (rule B). The Sun 2023 citation [15] has four dictionary rows and the stated 54,219 participants equals the sample size of none, so rule E gives no code.
